---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new controller, scenario or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What would you like?**
A short description of the feature.

**Why?**
The problem it solves or what it would let you explore.

**Ideas for how it could work** (optional)
For a new controller, say how it decides when to switch and roughly how you'd expect it to compare with the built-in ones.
